package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/form"
)

const pageHead = `<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>%s</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface p-4 text-ink"><main class="mx-auto max-w-2xl">`

func settings(theme string) string {
	field := form.RenderField(form.Field{
		Label: "Display name", For: "display-name", Help: "Shown only in this synthetic review.", Required: true,
		Control: template.HTML(form.RenderInput(form.Input{ID: "display-name", Name: "display_name", Value: "Alex Morgan", Required: true, HasHelp: true})),
	})
	sections, err := form.RenderSettingsSections([]form.SettingsSection{{
		HeadingID: "profile", Title: "Profile", Description: "Review a harmless local setting using native form behavior.", Content: template.HTML(field),
	}})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	help := form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Help", Variant: form.ButtonGhost, Href: "./help?theme=" + theme})
	cancel := form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Cancel unavailable", Variant: form.ButtonGhost, Href: "./cancel?theme=" + theme, Disabled: true})
	unsafe := form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Unsafe destination unavailable", Variant: form.ButtonDanger, Href: "javascript:alert('unsafe')"})
	review := form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Review settings", Variant: form.ButtonPrimary, Name: "action", Value: "review"})
	return fmt.Sprintf(pageHead, theme, "Button destination specimen") + `<h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold">Settings actions</h1><p class="mt-2 max-w-prose text-sm text-ink-muted">Synthetic values only. No account or setting is saved.</p><form class="mt-6" method="get" action="./review"><input type="hidden" name="theme" value="` + theme + `">` + sections + `<div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">` + help + cancel + unsafe + review + `</div><div class="mt-3 grid gap-1 text-sm text-ink-muted"><p>Cancel unavailable: unavailable while this synthetic draft is under review.</p><p>Unsafe destination unavailable: unavailable because the configured destination is invalid.</p></div></form></main></body></html>`
}

func simplePage(theme, title, message string) string {
	back := form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Back to settings", Variant: form.ButtonGhost, Href: "./settings?theme=" + theme})
	return fmt.Sprintf(pageHead, theme, title) + `<h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold">` + title + `</h1><p class="mt-3 max-w-prose text-ink-muted">` + message + `</p><div class="mt-6">` + back + `</div></main></body></html>`
}

func main() {
	type response struct {
		Path   string
		Status int
		Header map[string][]string
		Body   string
	}
	headers := map[string][]string{
		"Content-Type": {"text/html; charset=utf-8"}, "Content-Security-Policy": {"default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'"}, "Cache-Control": {"no-store"},
	}
	h := gallery.New()
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/static/app.css", nil))
	responses := []response{{"/static/app.css", w.Code, w.Header(), w.Body.String()}}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		responses = append(responses,
			response{"/_fixture/settings?theme=" + theme, 200, headers, settings(theme)},
			response{"/_fixture/help?theme=" + theme, 200, headers, simplePage(theme, "Settings help", "Use Review settings to inspect the submitted values. Nothing is persisted.")},
			response{"/_fixture/review?theme=" + theme, 200, headers, simplePage(theme, "Settings reviewed", "Native GET submitted Alex Morgan with the named review action. Nothing was saved.")},
		)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(responses); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
